definition: Explicit initial gateway shortlists for the supported countries and metros. These are editorial coverage choices, not traffic rankings, all scheduled-service airports, or a completeness claim. Every change requires a reviewed code-list diff and rationale; unmapped locations have no fallback.

country:JP.rationale: Initial Japan gateway shortlist: Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Sapporo, Fukuoka and Okinawa; domestic and international coverage, not every regional airport.

country:ID.rationale: Initial Indonesia gateway shortlist: Jakarta, Bali, Surabaya, Medan and Makassar; other islands and airports require Specific selection.

country:AU.rationale: Initial mainland gateway shortlist; regional and other capital airports require Specific selection.

country:GB.rationale: Initial London plus Manchester/Edinburgh gateway shortlist; not all UK airports.

country:SG.rationale: Changi gateway only; Seletar is not included.

metro:JP:TYO.rationale: Tokyo Haneda and Narita gateways using the pinned MAC association.

metro:ID:JKT.rationale: Jakarta Soekarno-Hatta and Halim gateways using the pinned MAC association.

metro:GB:LON.rationale: Explicit five-airport London shortlist; Southend excluded from this initial coverage choice.

metro:JP:OSA.rationale: Kansai and Itami shortlist; Kobe requires Specific selection.

metro:AU:MEL.rationale: Melbourne and Avalon gateways using the pinned MAC association.
